Handpiece – 2 Nos. per Set/Unit Cannulation Diameter 4 mm Weight of Handpiece 1,300 g, including battery Power of the System At least 170 W Maximum Speed with Attach 1,500 rpm ments Forward and Reverse Trigger Separate forward and reverse triggers shall be provided s Compatibility Handpiece shall be compatible with a radiolucent drive Instant switching between clockwise and counterclockwise rotation shall b Direction of Rotation e possible Sterilization The system shall be fully autoclavable Attachment Compatibility All attachments shall be compatible with a single handpiece Reliable protection of soft tissue through an integrated oscillation mode sh Soft-Tissue Protection all be provided 2. Power Module/Battery – 2 Nos. per Set/Unit Lithium-ion batteries, control unit and motor shall be integrated into the mod Integrated Components ule A mode selector switch shall be provided to select drilling/reaming, sawing an Mode Selector d oscillating drill modes Battery Status Display A display shall indicate the battery charge status Error Diagnosis A button or facility shall be provided for system error diagnosis

Weight of Module 500–700 g Battery Type Lithium-ion battery Battery Life Minimum battery life of 1,000 charge cycles Self-Discharge and Memo The battery shall have minimal self-discharge and no memory effect ry Effect Battery Capacity 1.2 Ah Maximum Charging Time Less than 60 minutes Battery Voltage 20–30 V Safety and Handling Batteries shall be safe and easy to handle in the operation theatre 3. Sterile Cover – 2 Nos. per Set/Unit Sterilization Fully autoclavable Function Shall facilitate the sterile transfer of the power module to the battery-powered handpiece 4. AO/ASIF Quick-Coupling Attachment – 1 No. per Set/Unit Cannulation Diameter 2nm Maximum Speed At least 1,400 rpm Maximum Torque at least 3 Nm 5. Drill Chuck Attachment with Key – 1 No. per Set/Unit Diameter of cannulation 4 mm Maximum Speed of atleast 1400 RPM Maximum Torque of atleast 3 Nm

6. Drill Chuck Keyless– 1 No. per Set/Unit Diameter of cannulation: 4 mm. Maximum speed: At least 1,400 rpm. Maximum torque: At least 3 Nm. 7. Quick Coupling for Medullary Reaming – 1 No. per Set/Unit Diameter of cannulation: 4 mm. Maximum speed: At least 300 rpm. Maximum torque: At least 13 Nm. 8. Quick Coupling for K-Wire – 1 No. per Set/Unit Should accept wires ranging from 1 mm to 4 mm. Maximum speed: At least 300 rpm. 9. Sagittal Saw Attachment – 1 No. per Set/Unit Maximum oscillating frequency: At least 10,000 oscillations per minute (os c/min). The Amplitude of Oscillation 4-5ﹾﹾ Saw blade for TJR Surgery: Length 80–100 mm, width 12.5–25 mm, and thi ckness 1 mm. Quantity: 10 Nos. 10. Case for Autoclaving – 1 No. per Set/Unit Intramedullary Reaming System – 1 No. per Set/Unit. The system should facilitate reduced pressure and minimal heat build-up during surgical application. The system should be capable of reaming in both clockwise and anticlockwise directions. The system should comprise separate reamer heads of suitable sizes, made of Nickel-Titanium alloy (Supe relastic). The system should be supplied with reamer diameters ranging from 5.5 mm to 13 mm, in increments of 0. 5 mm. .
